Name: Passable Descents
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]

[size=5][u]About[/u][/size]
[size=3]Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2985]Passable Ladders[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55967747]J_Hizzal[/url]

After the third time of entering a floor in the mines, seeing the enemy I need to defeat at the edge of my screen, and breaking the rock trapping me by the exit ladder just to have the ladder to the next area spawn and continue trapping me, I decided to get the mod that made ladders passable; Only to find out that it wasn't updated to 1.6.

This mod allows you to walk past ladders that spawn when breaking open rocks, ladders created by placing down stairs, and shafts created by breaking open rocks.[/size]

[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
[size=3]Works with the 1.6 PC version of Stardew Valley.
I don't have the game on anything else, so I can't currently say if it works anywhere else.
Works in multiplayer, everyone who wants to benefit from it needs to have it installed.
